top.line: Job-seeker websites that show evidence, built by an agentic cell, with personas to fork and a brief.
top.para: Seven pages, a page per employer, a recruiter pack, a ladder.

in-short.line: CVs trusted less; seven pages; a page for you; recruiters; make it yours; an agent team; personas and brief.

why.line: AI-generated applications make skills harder to verify, so proof beats a better list.

site.line: Home, evidence, thinking, me, a page for you, working with me, recruiter pack, plus machine files.
site.para: Privacy and consistency rules on every page.

personas.line: Eight synthetic people, from a developer to a graduate, each with a different site.

yours.line: Each site should look like its owner, not like every other AI site.
yours.para: The person geeks out and makes it theirs.

for-you.line: An unlisted, expiring page per application or meeting, with something made for that employer.
for-you.para: Public material only; anonymised when public.

recruiters.line: A one-screen pack on every site, and a recruiter's cell with shortlists from candidates' own pages.

pipeline.line: Interview, evidence, draft, make it yours, tailor, check, publish, by a team of six agent roles.
pipeline.para: QA blocks invented facts; the person approves and sends.

ladder.line: A free recipe, a free fork, then £500, £1,500, £5,000 and a recruiter's cell at £20,000.

us.line: A version for me, and for team members who want one, reviewed by them first.
us.para: The mock-ups are the references our sites lacked.

brief.line: Thirteen tasks: template, themes, interview, evidence, design, tailoring, QA, recruiters, tests, hub.
brief.para: Build from the mock-ups and cross-check.

limits.line: Invented personas; designs not a product; thin evidence for sites; first-proposal prices.

sources.line: Robert Half, Greenhouse, JSON Resume, llms.txt reports, admired personal sites, earlier articles.
